column1: # ---- 第三批：对话框正文 / 托盘与节点提示（v5） ----
# 注意：本段英文列含 \r \n \x20 转义（多行长文案与行尾空格），由 patch_zh.py 还原

Are you sure you want to enable Unattended Mode?\r\n\r\nIn Unattended Mode, Tailscale keeps running (as your identity) when you log out of Windows and keeps running even if the machine reboots or a different user logs in. Use the Tailscale CLI to use ACL Tags and run as a non-user account.
column2: 确定要启用无人值守模式？\r\n\r\n在无人值守模式下，您注销 Windows 后 Tailscale 仍以您的身份继续运行，重启或换其他用户登录也不会停止。如需使用 ACL 标签并以非用户账户运行，请使用 Tailscale 命令行。

column1:
Are you sure you want to run an exit node?

Running an exit node means other devices in your tailnet can send all their traffic through this computer's IP address.

Note: exit nodes running on Windows are not yet optimized; see Help for details.
column2:
确定要运行出口节点？

运行出口节点意味着网络中的其他设备可将全部流量通过本机 IP 地址发送。

注意：Windows 上的出口节点尚未优化，详见帮助。
